title: K-flat tensor transport for independent coefficient universes
statement: Let C be a site essentially small in the coefficient universe r, let O be a sheaf of commutative rings, and let A be its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let P be K-flat for the acyclic total-tensor predicate [def-pc-kflat-complex], at independent coefficient and site universes. For any quasi-isomorphism f:X→Y of cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the total tensor map f tensor id_P [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], in the canonical second-variable tensor model koszulTensorFunctor [def-pur-principal-koszul-quotient-towers], is a quasi-isomorphism. No regularity, tower, limit, completion or Roos-triangle assumptions are needed.

source.place: Tag 06YN, definition-K-flat; Tag 06YP, lemma-K-flat-quasi-isomorphism; parent Koszul reconstruction proof, step 2.

proof.text: The mapping cone of f is acyclic because f is a quasi-isomorphism. Tensoring that cone with the K-flat P is acyclic by definition. Tensor of sheaves is additive: it is sheafification of the sectionwise additive presheaf tensor and sheafification is additive. Apply CochainComplex.mapBifunctorMappingCone₁Iso to identify this total tensor with the cone of the tensor map, then apply the converse acyclic-cone criterion. This proves the result for arbitrary f, including f on zero complexes and an isomorphism, without any assumption on a section t.
